name: sd-webui-extension-tooling
description: Standardized linting, formatting, pre-commit and CI tooling for SD WebUI extensions

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:py && pnpm run lint:js
scripts.format: pnpm run format:py && pnpm run format:web
scripts.check: ruff check . && ruff format --check . && oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json . && oxfmt --check "**/*.{js,css,json,md}"
